distributions.name: d²σ/dp_μ dcosθ_μ
distributions.provenance: arXiv:2403.19574 e-print ancillary anc/basic_data_release/xsec_summary_table.txt (359 global bins, columns: bin, xsec, stat.err, total.err, in units of 1e-38 cm^2/Ar) and mat_table_cov_total.txt (359x359 covariance). Bin edges for all 14 kinematic blocks taken from the Appendix 'Bin definitions' Table (tab:bin_defs) in main.tex. Per main.tex Sec. 'Impact on integrated cross section' text, the tabulated per-bin values are BIN-INTEGRATED cross sections (obtainable by multiplying the differential cross section by the bin-width product), confirmed by exact numeric match with the supplemental Table I data (data_files/all_unf_slice_047_hist.txt) which is explicitly captioned as such; we DIVIDE by the (multi-dimensional) bin-width product to recover the differential dsigma/dX (or d2sigma/dXdY) values stored in the CSVs. Target is per-Ar-nucleus (not per-nucleon), following the paper's NumTargets = number of Ar nuclei in the fiducial volume. Error column = total (stat+syst combined in quadrature) = sqrt(diag(mat_table_cov_total.txt)), matches the 4th column of xsec_summary_table.txt exactly. Open (semi-infinite) upper/lower bin edges for delta_p_T, delta_p_Tx, delta_p_Ty, p_n were capped at physically reasonable finite values (delta_p_T<1.2, delta_p_Tx/delta_p_Ty in [-1.0,1.0], p_n<1.2 GeV/c) purely for CSV plotting purposes; the true last bin is open-ended in the paper.

covariance.note: 359x359 absolute covariance (units^2 of the differential cross section, i.e. 1e-38 cm^2/Ar per applicable widths), propagated from mat_table_cov_total.txt (bin-integrated cross section covariance) by dividing each element (i,j) by width_i*width_j (same widths used to convert the per-bin values to differential). Row/col order = distributions concatenated in the listed order (each 2d = its slices in order, each slice's bins in file order).
